jobs.title: Senior Technical Accountant
jobs.description:
Our Story
 
Hello there. We’re Zopa.
 
We started our journey back in 2005, building the first ever peer-to-peer lending company. Fast forward to 2020 and we launched Zopa Bank. A bank that listens to what our customers don’t like about finance and does the opposite. We’re redefining what it feels like to work in finance. Our vision for a new era of banking puts people front and centre — we’ve built a business that empowers everyone to aim high, every day, to move finance forward. Find out more about our fantastic offerings at Zopa.com! 
 
We’re incredibly proud of our achievements and none of it would be possible without the amazing team here. It’s not just industry awards we’re winning, we’ve also been named in the top three UK’s Most Loved Workplaces. 
 
If you embrace unconventional challenges, are unafraid to think differently and are driven to make an outsized impact, you’ll thrive here at Zopa, so join us, and make it count. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife

We are looking for a Senior Technical Accountant to join our growing Finance function, reporting to the Head of Technical Accounting. You’ll provide technical accounting support for ongoing business activities, new products and other initiatives, and play a key part in the Technical Accounting team’s work, from accounting policy assessments to horizon scanning, audit engagement and the annual report. Strong stakeholder management is key to this role. 

The demands on the Finance team are high as Zopa grows at pace, so you’ll need to build effective and influential relationships within Finance and the wider business. Our team are self-starting problem solvers who are agile and thrive on bringing past experiences and networks to a diverse range of challenges. You’ll be part of an impressive Zopa team, who are super collaborative and happy to roll their sleeves up and get involved in whatever needs doing to achieve their goals. 


A day in the life

  • Carry out technical accounting assessments for new transactions, products, significant contracts and other business initiatives, and draft clear accounting papers and memos. 

  • Play a key part in the Technical Accounting team’s ownership of the annual report and accounts, drafting parts of the report and coordinating other sections written by teams across Finance and the wider business, and helping to bring them together into the final report. 

  • Manage stakeholders effectively and work well with other Zopa teams, including Product, Legal, Treasury and Risk, building strong, influential relationships and giving clear, practical technical accounting advice. 

  • Support the development, implementation and upkeep of accounting policies and the accounting manual and give practical guidance on how policies should be applied across the business. 

  • Help put new accounting treatments into practice: make sure finance systems and processes are set up to support new activities, embed them into business-as-usual (BAU) processes and hand them over to the BAU teams. 

  • Support the technical accounting for balance sheet activity, including SPPI testing and hedge accounting assessments and documentation under IAS 39 and IFRS 9. 

  • Support the timely and accurate delivery of month-end reporting where needed. 

  • Work directly with the external auditors on accounting policy and technical accounting matters, answering queries and providing evidence and papers. 

  • Carry out horizon scanning of new and proposed legislation, regulation and accounting standards that affect financial and corporate reporting, prepare impact assessments, and highlight high-impact or high-risk changes. 

  • Help shape and deliver our work to automate the production of the annual report, an area where this role will be fundamental. 

  • Look for ways to use AI and automation to improve technical accounting, policy and reporting processes, and put them into practice. 

  • Keep up to date with developments in financial and corporate reporting. 


About you:

  • Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA or equivalent) with relevant post-qualification experience. 

  • Experience of working in the financial services sector (ideally banking or consumer finance), or trained at a top six accountancy firm with financial services experience in a technical accounting role. 

  • Solid working knowledge of IFRS and how it applies to financial services products and transactions. 

  • Clear written communication, with experience of drafting technical accounting papers or memos and explaining complex accounting to non-accountants. 

  • A questioning mindset, and the ability to drive change to systems and processes to improve efficiency. 

  • A team player and problem solver. You’ll show great initiative to listen, analyse, research, investigate and provide solutions to problems relating to financial accounting and reporting. 

  • Comfortable managing several pieces of work at once in a fast-moving environment, and building trusted relationships with stakeholders at all levels. 

  • Curious about AI and how you can use it in your everyday work. 

  • Motivated, energetic and passionate about excellence and innovation. 


Bonus points for

  • Technical knowledge of IFRS 9 (expected credit losses, EIR), hedge accounting (IFRS 9 and IAS 39), IFRS 2 (share-based payments), and IAS 38 (intangible assets). 

  • Experience of operational accounting. 

#LI-LK1

At Zopa we value flexible ways of working.

We value face-to-face collaboration and a good work-life balance. This hybrid role requires you to come to our London office 2-3 days a week.

You'll also have the option of working from abroad for up to 120 days a year!* But no matter where you are, we’ll make sure you’ve got everything you need to thrive, both in your work and home life, from day one.

*Subject to having the right to work in the country of choice

 

Diversity Statement

Zopa is proud to offer a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to better products for our customers and a unique company culture for our people. We are made up of nearly 50 nationalities, have a DE&I forum made up of Zopians wanting to make a difference and we are proud of our culture where everyone can bring their full self to work. Our approach to DE&I is reflected in our hiring process so please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments. 

 

Our approach to AI in interviews

At Zopa, AI isn't something we're testing out — it's part of how we work every day. As a proud partner of Jobs 2030, we're committed to building AI fluency across our workforce, and we expect Zopians to use AI as part of how they do their jobs. 

Because of that, we want to be transparent about how we think about AI use during our hiring process. 

Behavioural and competency-based interviews: please don't use AI. These conversations are designed to understand you — your experiences, your judgment, and how you've approached real situations. An AI-generated answer can't tell us that. What it can do is get in the way of us finding out whether we're the right fit for each other. 

Technical interviews: it depends on the role. Some technical stages actively welcome AI use, others don't. Your Talent Partner will let you know what's expected at each stage. Where AI is part of the assessment, we'll be interested not just in the outcome, but in how you used it – the tools you chose, your reasoning, and the decisions you made along the way.

At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts: procurement – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger 50+ emails, and pull in Finance, Legal, Security, and IT just to get something approved.

We’ve raised $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners, and Accel to change that. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility.

The opportunity is massive. Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it. We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the 4th fastest growing startup in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for.

Our team previously scaled Tessian (cybersecurity tech, backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel, acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like Ben, Abs, Sabrina, and Rebe.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone hungry to learn and early in their career to join us as our Revenue Operations Associate!

You'll get an inside look at, and be a key part of, how a high-performing GTM function operates: this is a great opportunity for exceptionally smart, motivated individuals who want to immerse themselves in the world of tech startups and gain real exposure to what it takes to keep a high-growth business moving.

You'll sit at the intersection of our GTM, Customer and Finance teams, keeping our systems, data, and reporting sharp as we scale. This isn't a "keep the lights on" role – you'll inherit processes that are still being built, and you'll have real room to audit what's working, fix what isn't, and put your own stamp on how we operate.

You'll get broad exposure early: one week you might be untangling a HubSpot workflow, the next you're building a dashboard the CCO takes into a board meeting. It's a genuinely excellent grounding in how a B2B SaaS business scales – but it comes with real pace, longer hours than a typical first job, and a learning curve to match. If you want breadth of exposure and a steep climb early in your career, this is a great seat.

What Can You Expect?

  • Keep our GTM tech stack in good shape: Own day-to-day CRM administration – data hygiene, permissions, and workflow upkeep – and support the configuration and integration of the wider stack.

  • Stay ahead of what's new: Keep across releases and new features across our tools – joining release webinars, reading release notes, and flagging what's worth adopting.

  • Help evaluate and set up new tools: Get involved as we add to the stack, from evaluation through to implementation.

  • Improve our data quality: Spot where data is incomplete or inconsistent, fix what you can, and propose fixes for the rest.

  • Build reporting and dashboards: Turn raw data into dashboards and reports that track pipeline health, funnel conversion, and the other KPIs the GTM team relies on day to day.

  • Support incentive tracking: Help maintain and monitor commission and incentive tracking, making sure calculations are accurate.

  • Onboard new GTM joiners: Train new starters across the GTM and Customer teams on our tools and processes so they're productive quickly.

  • Own our recurring admin cadence: Take ownership of the regular tasks that keep the engine running and look to automate where ever possible.

About You

  • You have a top-class academic record: you'll have graduated with (or be on track for) a 1st class degree, or have attended one of the top universities in the country you studied in – we're looking for a strong, proven track record of academic performance as the clearest early signal of the analytical rigour this role needs.

  • You're curious about how technology fits together: you likely have a STEM background, and you enjoy working out how systems, data, and workflows connect to make a business run – even if you've never worked in RevOps before.

  • You want pace, eyes open: you're drawn to a fast-scaling business precisely because of the pace, and you understand that means longer hours and a steeper learning curve than a typical grad role. You see that as a trade worth making.

  • You're happy to get stuck in: you know not every task here is glamorous – some of it is spreadsheet clean-up, data hygiene, or repetitive admin – and you take real satisfaction in doing that work well, not just the exciting parts.

  • You want to understand how B2B SaaS businesses scale: you're looking to build a first-hand understanding of the GTM engine – pipeline, systems, data, and the commercial mechanics behind it – as a foundation for wherever your career goes next.

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

jobs.title: Chief Engineer Operations H/F
jobs.description:
📍 Paris / Île-de-France | Environnement Data Center | CDI | Périmètre multisite

Rejoignez mon client au cœur des infrastructures critiques.

Dans un contexte de forte croissance et de développement de ses infrastructures, mon client renforce son organisation Operations en France et crée un poste de Chief Engineer.

Au sein d'un nouvel pôle d'expertise technique transverse, vous devenez le référent technique des opérations sur plusieurs sites stratégiques en France, avec un périmètre prioritaire couvrant notamment deux sites.

Votre mission : apporter votre expertise, sécuriser les opérations et contribuer à faire progresser l'ensemble de l'organisation vers davantage de standardisation, de rigueur opérationnelle et d'excellence technique.

Ce poste s'adresse à un profil expérimenté qui souhaite aller au-delà de l'expertise technique pure et jouer un rôle central dans la structuration des opérations d'un acteur Data Center en pleine croissance.

Vos missions

Votre rôle

Le Chief Engineer intervient comme référent technique et opérationnel multisite.

Vous êtes à la fois :

  • un expert technique capable de challenger les équipes et les prestataires ;

  • un référent opérationnel garant de la sécurisation des opérations ;

  • un acteur transverse capable de fédérer des équipes aux profils et niveaux d'expérience différents.

Vous disposez d'une véritable autorité technique : lorsque les conditions de sécurité ou de maîtrise des risques ne sont pas réunies, vous êtes capable de challenger une opération et, si nécessaire, de prononcer un NO GO sur un mode opératoire ou une intervention.

Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les responsables de site, qui conservent la responsabilité opérationnelle de leur périmètre.

Vos principales missions

1 - Être le référent technique des infrastructures critiques

Vous apportez votre expertise sur l'ensemble des infrastructures techniques du Data Center et êtes capable d'en comprendre les interactions et les impacts opérationnels.

Votre périmètre couvre notamment :

  • les infrastructures électriques HT/BT ;

  • les systèmes de secours électrique ;

  • les UPS / onduleurs ;

  • les groupes électrogènes ;

  • les infrastructures CVC / HVAC ;

  • les systèmes de refroidissement ;

  • la protection et la sécurité incendie ;

  • les systèmes de contrôle-commande et infrastructures associées.

Vous intervenez comme référent technique auprès des responsables de site et des équipes Operations, et êtes capable de challenger les différents interlocuteurs internes ou externes sur leurs choix et leurs pratiques.

2 - Sécuriser les opérations

L'une de vos responsabilités majeures sera de garantir que les opérations réalisées sur les infrastructures critiques sont préparées et exécutées dans les meilleures conditions de sécurité et de maîtrise des risques.

À ce titre, vous :

  • challengez les modes opératoires (MOP) ;

  • vérifiez la cohérence et l'exhaustivité des procédures ;

  • identifiez les risques et leurs impacts potentiels ;

  • sécurisez les opérations avant leur réalisation ;

  • challengez les premières analyses et propositions d'intervention ;

  • pouvez émettre un NO GO lorsqu'une opération ne présente pas les garanties nécessaires ;

  • accompagnez les responsables de site dans la prise de décision technique ;

  • contribuez à la mise en place de mécanismes de double vérification.

Vous êtes en quelque sorte le garde-fou technique de l'organisation, avec pour objectif de sécuriser les opérations sans perdre de vue les impératifs de continuité de service.

3- Structurer et harmoniser les pratiques

L'un des enjeux majeurs du poste est de contribuer à l'harmonisation des pratiques entre les différents sites.

Aujourd'hui, les niveaux de maturité et les pratiques peuvent varier d'un site à l'autre. Votre rôle sera de contribuer à construire un socle commun de méthodes et de standards opérationnels.

Vous serez notamment amené(e) à :

  • structurer les processus d'exploitation ;

  • définir et harmoniser les standards techniques ;

  • rédiger et améliorer les procédures et modes opératoires ;

  • mettre en place des workflows opérationnels ;

  • contrôler leur bonne application ;

  • identifier les écarts entre les sites ;

  • proposer et suivre les plans d'amélioration ;

  • partager les bonnes pratiques ;

  • réaliser des REX multisites ;

  • accompagner les équipes dans l'adoption des nouveaux standards.

La capacité à construire et faire vivre des process sera donc aussi importante que votre expertise technique.

4- Apporter votre expertise lors des incidents critiques

En cas d'incident technique complexe, vous intervenez comme référent technique auprès des équipes Facility et Operations.

Vous êtes notamment amené(e) à :

  • analyser techniquement l'incident ;

  • identifier les causes et les impacts potentiels ;

  • apporter votre expertise aux responsables de site ;

  • challenger les analyses proposées ;

  • accompagner les équipes internes et les prestataires ;

  • contribuer à la définition des actions correctives ;

  • participer à la résolution de l'incident ;

  • organiser et partager les retours d'expérience à l'échelle des différents sites.

Votre capacité à prendre du recul, analyser rapidement une situation complexe et apporter une réponse techniquement robuste sera essentielle.

5 - Développer une culture d'excellence opérationnelle

Vous ne vous contentez pas de définir les standards : vous accompagnez les équipes dans leur appropriation.

Vous serez ainsi amené(e) à :

  • former et accompagner les équipes ;

  • expliquer les exigences techniques et opérationnelles ;

  • faire progresser les pratiques ;

  • fédérer autour d'objectifs communs ;

  • accompagner la conduite du changement ;

  • favoriser le partage de connaissances entre les sites.

Vous disposez d'une forte capacité d'influence et savez faire avancer les sujets sans nécessairement disposer d'un lien hiérarchique direct.

6 - Être l'interlocuteur technique des clients majeurs

Vous serez capable de :

  • représenter la société sur les sujets techniques ;

  • expliquer une situation ou un incident complexe ;

  • présenter les actions mises en œuvre ;

  • répondre aux interrogations techniques des clients ;

  • apporter un discours structuré et crédible sur les enjeux d'exploitation et de sécurité des infrastructures.

Une organisation en construction

Vous rejoindrez un pôle d'expertise technique transverse nouvellement structuré, regroupant différentes compétences destinées à accompagner les opérations et les projets.

L'objectif est de créer une véritable communauté d'experts capable d'apporter son expertise à l'ensemble des sites et de faire progresser collectivement les standards d'exploitation.

Vous travaillerez au quotidien avec :

  • les responsables de site ;

  • les équipes Facility et Operations ;

  • les équipes projets ;

  • les experts techniques ;

  • les prestataires et partenaires externes ;

  • les fonctions transverses ;

  • les clients majeurs.

Le poste est donc particulièrement transverse et nécessite une forte capacité à créer du lien entre les différentes parties prenantes.

Vos compétences

Votre profil

Vous disposez d'une expérience significative dans un environnement Data Center ou infrastructure critique fortement structurée.

Vous avez idéalement évolué dans un environnement où les exigences en matière de procédures, de sécurité opérationnelle, de maintenance et de continuité de service sont particulièrement élevées.

Une expérience dans un environnement critique comparable serait particulièrement appréciée.

Votre expertise technique

Vous disposez d'une excellente connaissance des infrastructures critiques et notamment :

  • électricité HT/BT ;

  • systèmes de secours électrique ;

  • UPS / groupes électrogènes ;

  • CVC / HVAC ;

  • refroidissement ;

  • protection incendie ;

  • contrôle-commande ;

  • maintenance des infrastructures critiques.

Vous êtes capable de comprendre l'intégralité de l'infrastructure et les interactions entre les différents systèmes, et pas uniquement votre domaine d'expertise initial.

Vous savez également analyser une problématique technique complexe, identifier les risques et challenger les solutions proposées.

Votre expérience opérationnelle

Vous avez déjà évolué dans un environnement où les procédures et les standards opérationnels occupent une place importante.

Vous êtes à l'aise avec :

  • les modes opératoires (MOP) ;

  • la gestion des changements ;

  • l'analyse de risques ;

  • la maintenance préventive et corrective ;

  • la gestion d'incidents critiques ;

  • les audits et contrôles opérationnels ;

  • les REX ;

  • la standardisation des pratiques ;

  • la gestion de prestataires techniques.

Vous avez surtout envie de faire progresser une organisation, de structurer les pratiques et d'améliorer durablement les opérations.

Vos qualités

Pour réussir dans ce rôle, nous recherchons une personne :

  • dotée d'une forte expertise technique ;

  • structurée et rigoureuse ;

  • capable d'analyse et de prise de recul ;

  • pédagogue et capable de transmettre son expertise ;

  • à l'aise pour challenger ses interlocuteurs ;

  • capable de prendre des décisions et de défendre une position technique ;

  • dotée d'une forte intelligence relationnelle ;

  • capable de s'adapter à différents profils et différents niveaux de maturité ;

  • fédératrice et à l'aise dans un rôle transverse ;

  • capable d'accompagner la conduite du changement.

Votre capacité à adapter votre communication à votre interlocuteur tout en maintenant un haut niveau d'exigence technique sera déterminante.

Avantages

  • Déplacements : indemnité de véhicule forfaitaire sur 12 mois de 1 500 €

  • De la participation équivalent à 1-1.5 mois de salaire

Dann gestalte mit uns den internationalen Versand von morgen.

Über pakajo

Ship global, pay local. Mit pakajo machen wir internationalen Versand für E-Commerce-Unternehmen einfacher, transparenter und wirtschaftlicher.

Unsere digitale Vergleichs- und Versandplattform verbindet Versandkostenvergleich, Buchung, Labelerstellung, Tracking und digitale Zollprozesse. Dabei kombinieren wir internationale Transportwege mit der lokalen Zustellung durch unsere Versandpartner. Über Schnittstellen zu Shops und Marktplätzen integrieren wir den Versand direkt in die Abläufe unserer Kunden.

Seit unserem Plattformstart im Juli 2022 haben wir mehr als 1,6 Millionen Sendungen abgewickelt. Über 1.600 Geschäftskunden und mehr als 130 Carrier- und Preiskombinationen bilden die Grundlage für unser weiteres Wachstum. Wir bauen unser internationales Netzwerk aus und entwickeln unsere Plattform mit Automatisierung und KI kontinuierlich weiter.

As the Senior Documentation Specialist, you ensure the effective management, quality, completeness, and inspection readiness of essential clinical trial documentation for assigned studies, programmes or documentation activities, including the sponsor TMF and oversight of CRO and laboratory TMFs. Someone who takes ownership. From packaging and brand worlds to the smallest details that ultimately make the difference.

Someone who challenges existing ideas, wants to improve things and does not accept “the way it has always been done.”

This role is demanding, fast-paced and highly hands-on.

We are not looking for an administrator.

We are looking for a builder.

Someone who takes ownership, moves fast and executes with high quality.

Someone who wants to actively shape and grow brands. Not only conceptually, but all the way through to finished products in the market.

Aufgaben

You own everything that moves our brands visually and creatively forward with a clear focus on FMCG performance in the market.

  • Develop and execute creative concepts across all brands with a focus on visibility, recognition and impact
  • Build, sharpen and continuously evolve strong brand worlds with a consistent visual identity

  • Develop web, social and marketing assets focused on performance, not aesthetics alone

Turn design into products that sell. Turn creativity into performance.

  • 2–5+ years of experience in a creative role (Design, Art Direction or similar)

  • You take ownership instead of waiting for instructions
  • You use AI as a practical tool in your daily creative workflow

Purely aesthetic thinking without understanding market dynamics, consumers and commercial impact

Creative profiles without genuine interest in FMCG, retail and market-driven design

Very rigid or overly process-driven ways of working

People who wait for instructions instead of taking ownership

People who love concepts but struggle with execution and speed

Benefits

Direct collaboration with the Head of Brands

Real impact on brands, products and their success in market

Fast decisions instead of endless alignment rounds

High ownership and the opportunity to truly build and shape things

If you want to build something meaningful, this is the place.

You will not simply design.

You will build brands.

You will develop products that get noticed.

Products that stop consumers at shelf.

Products that win.

Products that people buy.

If you are someone who wants to create things that are not just beautiful, but successful, we should talk.

jobs.title: Technicien Réseaux & Télécom Itinérant (H/F)
jobs.description:
Poste : Technicien (position 2.1, coefficient 275, convention collective Syntec) · Basé en France · Interventions sur notre infrastructure, partout en France et à l'international

Vous aimez le terrain, les sites qui ne se ressemblent pas et le moment où le lien monte enfin. Chez Azurreo, vous installez, raccordez, testez et dépannez notre propre infrastructure réseaux et télécoms, celle qui fait tourner nos activités et nos plateformes à travers le monde.

Un poste de terrain, mais avec des horaires fixes du lundi au vendredi, des heures supplémentaires payées et inscrites au contrat, des frais avancés par l'entreprise, et vos habilitations financées si vous ne les avez pas encore.

Qui nous sommes

Azurreo est la branche télécommunications et technologies de Seelon Holdings, groupe d'investissement international présent sur quatre continents. Nous sommes un acteur de référence du test de performance des réseaux : notre plateforme SignalVerify mesure la qualité de service et la qualité d'expérience des réseaux dans plus de 144 pays.

Depuis plus de quinze ans, nous accompagnons opérateurs télécoms, intégrateurs, constructeurs et grandes entreprises dans le déploiement et la maintenance de leurs infrastructures en Europe, au Moyen-Orient et en Afrique : plus de 250 projets livrés dans plus de 25 pays.

Pour soutenir cette activité, Azurreo exploite et entretient son propre réseau d'infrastructures techniques en France et à l'international. C'est cette infrastructure que vous aurez en charge : celle qui permet à nos équipes et à nos plateformes de fonctionner, jour après jour, partout où nous sommes présents.

À quoi ressemble une semaine

Aucune semaine n'est identique :

  • Installation. Montage d'une baie sur l'un de nos sites, raccordement, brassage, étiquetage, tests, mise en service.

  • Dépannage. Une liaison qui ne monte pas depuis trois jours. Le plan de câblage ne correspond pas à l'existant. Vous cherchez, vous mesurez, vous trouvez, et vous écrivez ce que vous avez trouvé.

  • Datacenter. Rack & stack, cross-connects, mise en place d'équipements actifs.

  • Déploiement multi-sites. Plusieurs de nos sites dans la même semaine : bornes Wi-Fi, switches, configuration de base, comptes rendus.

  • Missions à l'international. Certaines semaines vous emmènent sur nos sites hors de France.

  • Journées base arrière. Préparation du matériel, gestion des stocks et de l'outillage, maintenance préventive, mise à jour des tickets. Toutes les semaines ne sont pas des semaines de route.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Installation et déploiement. Installation et mise en service d'équipements télécoms et informatiques sur nos sites. Câblage, raccordement et brassage. Déploiement de routeurs, switches, bornes Wi-Fi et équipements de connectivité. Préparation du matériel avant intervention, participation aux migrations et déploiements sur nos infrastructures.

  • Maintenance et support technique. Maintenance préventive et corrective de nos équipements. Diagnostic des incidents et mise en œuvre des dépannages. Remplacement et reconfiguration d'équipements défectueux. Vérification du bon fonctionnement après intervention.

  • Suivi et reporting. Rédaction des comptes rendus d'intervention, mise à jour des outils de suivi et des tickets d'incidents, gestion du matériel confié, participation aux stocks et inventaires, remontée des anomalies aux équipes concernées.

  • Qualité et sécurité. Respect des procédures qualité et sécurité d'Azurreo et des consignes propres à chaque site, usage approprié des équipements et outils mis à disposition.

Les technologies que vous rencontrerez

  • Réseaux : TCP/IP, VLAN, DHCP, DNS, VPN, LAN / WAN

  • Constructeurs : Cisco, Huawei, Aruba, Fortinet, Juniper

  • Télécoms : fibre optique, FTTH, FTTO, RJ45, brassage, baies informatiques

  • Datacenter : rack & stack, cross-connect, installation, maintenance

Vous ne maîtrisez pas tout cela ? Personne ne le maîtrise entièrement. Nous cherchons de bonnes bases techniques, de la curiosité et de la rigueur. Le reste s'apprend.

Parlons des déplacements franchement

  • Les déplacements en France et à l'international font partie intégrante du poste : ce n'est pas occasionnel, c'est une exigence.

  • Le rythme varie réellement selon les projets : certaines semaines sans déplacement, d'autres avec des découchés en France ou à l'étranger. Nous ne garantissons pas de rythme fixe.

  • Le véhicule utilitaire est mis à disposition pour les interventions en France : ce n'est pas un véhicule de fonction et il ne rentre pas chez vous le soir.

  • Les imprévus font partie du métier : matériel non livré, local fermé, câblage existant non conforme au plan.

  • Il y a de la manutention, des faux plafonds et des locaux techniques exigus.

  • En contrepartie : tous les frais professionnels sont pris en charge en amont, les horaires restent fixes, les heures supplémentaires sont payées, et vous ne passez pas vos journées au même bureau à faire la même chose.

Le profil que nous cherchons

Indispensable

  • Résider en France

  • Permis B en cours de validité

  • Disponible pour des déplacements fréquents, en France et à l'international

  • Formation ou expérience dans les télécommunications, les réseaux ou les infrastructures techniques

  • Connaissances en réseaux informatiques, câblage RJ45 et fibre optique

  • Capacité à diagnostiquer et résoudre des incidents techniques

  • Français courant, anglais niveau A2 minimum (à l'oral et pour lire de la documentation technique)

  • Maîtrise des outils bureautiques courants

  • Autonomie, rigueur, organisation

  • Capacité à travailler en mobilité et à vous adapter à des environnements techniques variés

Apprécié, mais pas exigé

  • Anglais au-delà du niveau A2

  • Expérience sur équipements Cisco, Huawei, Aruba, Fortinet ou Juniper

  • Fibre optique : raccordement, soudure, mesures. Wi-Fi, datacenter

  • Certifications réseau (CCNA ou équivalent) et habilitations à jour : AIPR, habilitation électrique, travail en hauteur, CACES nacelle, SST. Si vous ne les avez pas, nous organisons la formation pour que vous les obteniez.

Formation : Bac Pro SN, BTS SIO, BTS CIEL, BTS Télécommunications, BUT/DUT Réseaux & Télécommunications, Licence professionnelle Réseaux, ou expérience équivalente. Ce que vous avez fait compte autant que ce que vous avez étudié.

Ce que nous vous offrons

  • Des horaires fixes du lundi au vendredi et pas d'astreinte

  • Des heures supplémentaires payées, majorées et inscrites au contrat

  • Des frais avancés par l'entreprise

  • Vos certifications et habilitations financées si vous ne les avez pas

  • Une formation continue réelle, avec accès direct aux ingénieurs de l'entreprise

  • Des missions variées, en France et à l'international, sur notre propre infrastructure

  • Une entreprise internationale à taille humaine

Le processus de recrutement

  • Étude de votre candidature par notre équipe recrutement

  • Entretien RH, en visio (30 à 40 min), avec le recrutement, sur votre parcours, vos attentes et le poste en détail

  • Entretien technique (45 à 60 min) avec votre futur manager, sur la technique, le terrain et votre méthode

  • Entretien final (30 min) avec Adam Anbari, gérant d'Azurreo EURL

L'embauche est conditionnée à une visite médicale d'aptitude au poste.

Comment candidater

Envoyez-nous votre CV. Pas besoin de lettre de motivation ; quelques lignes sur une intervention dont vous êtes fier (ce qu'il y avait à faire, ce qui a coincé, comment vous l'avez réglé) nous parlent davantage.

Azurreo étudie toutes les candidatures à compétences égales, sans distinction d'origine, de sexe, d'âge, de situation personnelle ou de handicap.

jobs.title: Finance Manager
jobs.description:
We’re building the next generation of employee benefits infrastructure.

At Happl, we help global teams design, manage, and scale benefits that actually work for their people by using AI, across flex allowances, benefits, insurance, recognition, and wellbeing, all in one intelligent platform.

Happl is backed by leading investors such as YCombinator, 6Degrees Capital, Haatch, Portage, and more, known for backing leading companies such as Deel, Rippling, Airbnb, Coinbase, Dropbox, and most recently was awarded a place in the UK’s top 100 startups for 2026.

About the role

As Financial Controller at Happl, you’ll own the financial engine of the business — everything from the cash in the bank to the numbers our board and investors use to make decisions runs through you. You’ll run the monthly close, the full revenue cycle, the compliance calendar across two jurisdictions, and our treasury position, and you’ll decide how all of it gets built, systemised, and automated.

This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role with a direct line to leadership. You won’t be managing a process someone else designed — you’ll be deciding what good looks like across revenue, cash, compliance, and reporting, then making it happen. You’ll work closely with the CEO, the board, our investors, and our outsourced bookkeeping, audit, and tax partners, holding all of it to a standard that matches the product we’ve built.

We’re FCA-regulated and YCombinator-backed, having raised $11m to date, and we give global employers a single place to design, deliver, and manage benefits across 160+ countries and 70+ languages — which means the finance function behind the product has to be just as sharp as the product itself. We’re entering our next phase of growth, with an ambitious revenue trajectory and an expanding international footprint, and this role sits at the centre of it.

What you’ll be doing

  • Owning the monthly close on a fixed timetable — management accounts, balance sheet integrity, accruals, prepayments, and the revenue and cost reconciliations that sit behind them

  • Writing the commentary that explains what’s actually happened in the business, not just what the numbers say

  • Producing the monthly investor reporting pack and the financial sections of board materials — ARR and revenue analysis, cash and runway, burn efficiency, unit economics, cohort and retention metrics, and budget versus actual

  • Owning the full revenue cycle — invoicing, collections, aged debt, and revenue recognition across a multi-currency, multi-contract subscription base

  • Leading the rollout of automated billing and revenue recognition tooling, moving us from manual tracking to a system that scales without adding headcount

  • Managing our two legal entities — a US TopCo and a UK operating company — including statutory accounts, audit preparation, intercompany accounting, transfer pricing mechanics, and FX exposure between them

  • Owning the compliance calendar end to end across both jurisdictions — UK VAT returns, corporation tax, US federal and state filings, sales tax where applicable, and payroll taxes

  • Supporting our FCA regulatory reporting obligations and the financial controls that sit behind them

  • Running monthly payroll across jurisdictions, pension and benefits administration, employee expenses, and the finance side of onboarding and offboarding

  • Owning the cash position and treasury strategy — cash flow forecasting, working capital, FX management, and structuring how we hold company funds to earn a sensible return without taking risk we shouldn’t

  • Managing our outsourced bookkeeping, accounting, and tax partners — holding them to deadlines and quality, and pulling work in-house where doing so makes us faster

  • Owning the finance tech stack and having a strong opinion on it, actively replacing manual work with automation and AI-assisted workflows across reconciliations, invoice processing, variance analysis, and reporting drafts

  • Leveraging AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT to speed up your own work and build the systems that let finance scale without adding headcount

  • Acting as the financial conscience of the business, with a direct line to the founders and a real say in how we grow

What we’re looking for

  • Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA or CIMA), or qualified by experience with a track record that stands up to scrutiny

  • Genuine ownership of a monthly close cycle and management reporting pack, start to finish

  • Strong technical grounding in revenue recognition, accruals accounting, and balance sheet control

  • Comfortable with tax and compliance across VAT, corporation tax, and payroll, ideally spanning both the UK and US

  • AI-native in your approach — you already use AI tools in your day-to-day work and can talk specifically about what you’ve automated and what it saved you

  • Exceptional attention to detail, alongside the judgement to know when precision matters and when speed does

  • A clear communicator — you can explain a number to a non-finance audience without patronising them or losing them

  • Ideally, SaaS or subscription business experience, particularly ARR reporting and deferred revenue, and familiarity with modern billing infrastructure like Xero or Stripe

  • Comfort with SQL, Python, or low-code automation tools is a bonus, not a requirement, but it will make your life here significantly easier

What to expect

Being Financial Controller at Happl is not a maintenance role. You’ll be building the finance function as you run it — choosing the systems, designing the controls, and deciding how billing, revenue recognition, and reporting should work as we scale into new markets and currencies. That’s not a caveat; it’s the role.

Some weeks will be genuinely rewarding — a reporting pack you built gives the board real clarity, a manual process you automated saves the team hours every month, a treasury decision you made puts real value on the table. Some will be hard — closing the books on a fixed timetable, holding partners and advisors to a deadline, and making judgement calls across two jurisdictions with incomplete information.

What you get in return is real scope. You’ll own the whole picture — revenue, cash, compliance, treasury, and reporting — across two jurisdictions and 160+ countries of operations, with a direct line to the founders and reporting that goes straight to the board and our investors. This is the foundation of a finance function that will grow with the business, and the right person grows with it.

Why join Happl

  • Be part of building something that genuinely matters — the future of how companies support their people

  • Competitive salary that reflects the impact you’ll have

  • Real equity — a meaningful stake in what we’re building together

  • Hybrid working from day one, with the trust and flexibility to do your best work

  • Your own Happl account — use the platform you’re helping to build and shape

  • Private Health Insurance, because we genuinely care about how you’re doing

  • Dental insurance, including family cover

  • A personal Wellbeing budget to spend however wellbeing works for you — no questions asked

  • A dedicated L&D budget to grow in the direction that excites you

  • Pension — we’re invested in your future, not just the short term

About the Interview

  • Stage 2: Short task

  • Stage 3: 30-min deep dive and task review with Ben T (CEO) & Ben S (Ops)

Additional Details

  • Team: Finance

  • Reports to: CEO

About Notabene

Notabene is building infrastructure that’s transforming how money moves in the digital economy. We’re evolving beyond our compliance foundations to enable the next generation of digital financial services between regulated institutions with unprecedented efficiency. With nearly 50 employees across 14 countries and having recently closed our Series B round last November with support from leading investors including Y Combinator, DRW, F-Prime, Jump Capital, Castle Island, and Green Visor Capital, we’re looking for people like you to help shape the future rails of the crypto industry.

Location: Remote, within EMEA time zones.

The impact you will have:

At Notabene, the success of our customers drives everything that we do, and our Customer Success team is at the heart of that. You will own a book of customers across EMEA, from crypto-native exchanges and payment providers through to the financial institutions and fintechs now launching digital asset products.

Sales closes the initial deal and hands the customer over at signature. From there they are yours: get them live, get them using the product, renew them and grow them. The commercial conversation sits with you, which means renewals, pricing and upsells are yours to run.

You are also a technical point of contact for your customers. These conversations get technical early, and you should be able to sit with a customer's integration team and be useful. Comfort with APIs and the curiosity to work things out yourself matter more here than an engineering background.

Within a year you are successful if…

  • Net retention across your book has grown, and you can name the renewals and upsells that did it

  • Your customers are live and using the product, and the ones at risk were identified early

  • You have found and qualified upsell opportunities inside your existing customers, and converted a good number of them

  • Customers come to you first, on their compliance programme and on their commercial relationship with us

  • You can demonstrate real knowledge of our product and of the wider industry

What you will be doing:

  • Owning the post-sales journey for your customers: onboarding, adoption, business reviews, renewal and upsell

  • Running your own renewals and upsells, including pricing and the conversation with the economic buyer

  • Guiding customers through their Travel Rule programmes and their stablecoin payment products

  • Working directly with customer integration teams: API documentation, test calls, transaction and webhook data, and a clear diagnosis when something is stuck

  • Monitoring usage, engagement and risk signals, and acting on them with a clear plan well before they become a renewal problem

  • Finding growth inside your existing customers across adjacent teams, entities and products, and working with Sales on the net-new ones

  • Building relationships across compliance, operations and engineering, so the relationship never rests on one contact

  • Bringing customer and competitor insight back to product, sales and marketing

  • Keeping records current in HubSpot

  • Some on-call duty outside office hours

What you bring:

  • Based in EMEA, able to cover customers across the region

  • Around 5 years in Customer Success or Account Management at a crypto, fintech or regtech SaaS company, or in another complex technical market, managing your own book of customers

  • Commercial ownership. You have run your own renewals and upsells and negotiated pricing, without passing the deal back to Sales

  • Some technical range. You can work through API documentation, read a request and response, and form a view on why an integration is behaving the way it is

  • Experience across a mix of customers, from mid-market through to enterprise

  • Experience across the full lifecycle, from onboarding through to expansion

  • Exposure to compliance-driven or regulated environments

  • A doer. You own the detail yourself, and you move without waiting for a process to exist

  • Good judgement with people and real interest in solving their problems

  • Comfortable working autonomously and getting stuck in

Nice to Have

  • Travel Rule, stablecoin payments or digital asset compliance experience

  • Experience with banks and regulated financial institutions entering digital assets

  • Having built Customer Success processes and playbooks from scratch

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive Nordics
jobs.description:
Excited to lead AI-driven change across the Nordic legal market and build a region from the ground up? We would love to hear from you. 🇸🇪🇳🇴🇩🇰🇫🇮

Working from our London office or our HQ in Ghent, you’ll be LEGALFLY’s sales executive responsible for building out the Nordic region: Sweden, Norway, Denmark and Finland. LEGALFLY already works with customers across the Nordics and we see strong, growing interest in our product. Your mission is to turn that early traction into a scalable market, combining new business with expanding our presence among Nordic enterprises and law firms.

Join LEGALFLY!

LEGALFLY is a pioneering legal AI platform offering an end-to-end solution that is transforming the legal industry:

🏆 Exceptional product-market fit: Our advanced and intuitive legal AI solutions have rapidly gained traction in the market. LEGALFLY is trusted by leading European Enterprises and law firms, and we have strategic partnerships with industry leaders like Microsoft.

🚀 Hyper-growth: Following our successful Series A funding round of 15 million EUR, LEGALFLY is experiencing rapid growth. Backed by top investors, including Tier 1 VC funds.

🥇 World-class team: LEGALFLY was founded by four tech veterans, bringing extensive knowledge and expertise to drive innovation.

🔒 Unmatched security: We are setting the global standard for responsible legal AI with unrivalled security measures. LEGALFLY ensures that sensitive client data never leaves the company's premises through on-premise anonymisation.

🌎 Global expansion: Our recent funding will support our expansion across the globe. We are extending our platform to key jurisdictions, including the United States, United Kingdom, France, Netherlands, Belgium, UAE, DACH and the Nordics, driving the digital transformation of legal services globally.

Join us at LEGALFLY and be a part of our mission to revolutionise the legal industry with cutting-edge AI technology.

Key responsibilities:

  • Building a market. Own the Nordic region end to end, shaping the go-to-market approach, prioritising countries and segments and laying the foundation for future growth in the region.

  • Generating revenue. With ambitious but realistic revenue goals, you’ll be playing a key part in our growth, repeatedly closing mid to large enterprise opportunities across the Nordics.

  • Growing what’s already there. Build on our existing Nordic customer base, turning early adopters into references and expansion opportunities.

  • Opening doors. Build and grow your own pipeline, taking a data-driven approach to prospecting and following up on the inbound interest we already see, while expanding our brand presence in Sweden, Norway, Denmark and Finland.

  • Communicating like an expert. Educating companies on the transformative value of enterprise AI. Companies will feel delighted and informed by your interactions, looking to you for your expertise in embedding AI into their business.

  • Taking extreme ownership. Identify and actively address inefficiencies. We’re scaling fast and need to solve for any inefficiencies as we build.

You might be a fit if you are:

  • A top-performing AE with 5-10 years of B2B Enterprise level SaaS sales experience.

  • Experienced in selling into the Nordic market, with a good understanding of how buying decisions are made in the region.

  • Fluent in English, professional communication is required. Swedish, Norwegian, Danish or Finnish is a strong plus.

  • Client-centric, customers you’ve worked with in the past should rave about working with you.

  • Based in or near London or Ghent, working from one of our offices.

  • Comfortable with regular travel to the Nordics for client meetings, events and in-market presence.

  • Flexible and adaptive, with a history of leaving systems, processes and content better than you found them.

  • An exceptional collaborator and have a “we-all-win-together” mentality.

  • Relentlessly resourceful and resilient.

  • Entrepreneurial spirit with a keen understanding of business goals and a drive to exceed them.

  • Self-starter who can work independently as well as collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

  • A student of sales, always learning and eager to continue to develop as a professional.

  • Experience opening up a new region or being the first sales hire in a market.

  • Want to join a scale-up, take responsibility for the fate of the company, move fast and transform your career trajectory?


Our offer

🌟 A position with impact: Join a fast-growing tech scale-up with an innovative culture and tremendous market opportunity.

💰 A fully optimised & competitive remuneration package incl. ESOP

 💻 Top-class equipment to thrive: Including Macbook and Widescreen 34' monitor.

🏥 Investment in your well-being: top-notch health, hospital & dental insurance and a pension plan

🏡 Hybrid work policy

 🎉 Monthly team activities & yearly team retreat.

🏢 Stunning, light-filled office in the heart of London (Fitzrovia) or Ghent.

🍽️ Free lunch on office days Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays

Have we sparked your interest? Let’s get in touch & join the AI Revolution! 🚀

jobs.title: Succevol ingevuld: Senior growth marketeer @ Snelstart
jobs.description:
Vacature: Senior Growth Marketeer (B2B SaaS) @ Snelstart

 

•            Impact maken, versnellen en professionaliseren

•            Mandaat en vrijheid

•            Locatie: Amersfoort

•            Uren: 32–40 uur

•            Opleidingsniveau: Hbo

•            Salaris: €4.800 – €7.000 o.b.v. 40 uur

 

Voor onze opdrachtgever Snelstart zoekt Sound People een senior growth marketeer die strategie en data naadloos verbindt. Snelstart helpt dagelijks ondernemers, boekhouders en accountants slimmer te werken en groeit hard. Met 180.000 gebruikers is het een van de grootste boekhoud en accountancy software platforms van Nederland Jij wordt eigenaar van de volledige growth-loop: acquisitie, activatie en engagement, en werkt nauw samen met Marketing, Product, Data en Sales.

 

De rol van senior growth marketeer bij Snelstart

•   Ontwikkel, voer uit en schaal de growth-strategie voor self-serve en sales-led acquisitie.

•   Ontwerp en run high-impact experimenten over de hele funnel (campagnes, onboarding, pricing, funnels, content, AI-automatisering).

•   Analyseer gedrag en data diepgaand; identificeer patronen, kansen en bottlenecks.

•   Bouw repeatable growth loops en automatisering voor schaal.

•   Optimaliseer paid performance kanalen (creatives, audiences, attributie).

•   Co-creëer met Product voor betere activation, onboarding en retention.

•   Zet moderne tooling in: AI-personalisatie, marketing automation, tracking, testing, analytics.

•   Werk met leadership aan prioritering, rapportage en roadmap-invloed.

Waarom is deze rol interessant voor jou?

Er is veel te doen en je krijgt veel vrijheid én verantwoordelijkheid. Je maakt diepe impact en je mening wordt serieus genomen. Jouw data inzichten en suggesties vormen de basis voor belangrijke beslissingen en keuze die Snelstart gaat maken in de toekomst. Je zit én aan de knoppen én je bepaalt mede de richting voor verdere groei van de organisatie o.a. mbt tot klantinzichten. Daarnaast kun je experimenteren, testen, AI inzetten, optimaliseren en nauw samenwerken met product, marketing automation, marketing director en het MT.

 

Wat biedt Snelstart

•   Brutosalaris €4.800 – €7.000 (40 u/pw), afhankelijk van ervaring.

•   30 vakantiedagen (o.b.v. 40 uur), maandelijks vakantiegeld en pensioenbijdrage.

•   Hybride werken, modern benefits-pakket, laptop en ergonomische werkplek (zit-sta).

•   Toegang tot sportschool met bedrijfskorting.

•   Cultuur die data, snelheid en creativiteit omarmt; ruimte en budget voor tooling/experimenten.

•   Directe invloed op product, strategie en roadmap; doorgroeimogelijkheden in een schaalbare omgeving.

•   Een betrokken team met 200+ collega’s.

Spreekt dit jou aan?  Neem contact op met Sound People via Sven Fremeijer (

Wat is de procedure?

Na een succesvolle telefonische kennismaking volgt een face to face gesprek met Sven Fremeijer. Als we beiden voldoende aanleiding zien om verder te gaan stelt Sound je voor bij SnelStart. Daar volgen 2 gesprekrondes.

De eerste gespreksronde wordt gezamenlijk gevoerd door de directeur commercie en product en HR. De tweede ronde zal plaatsvinden met de directeur commercie en product en een externe adviseur. Daarna volgt een arbeidsvoorwaarden gesprek.

Slotopmerking

Deze functie is bedoeld voor een daadkrachtige verbinder die marketing discipline met pragmatisme combineert. Als jij de marketing van SnelStart wilt professionaliseren en de organisatie wilt helpen naar een voorspelbare, succesvolle ‘marketingmachine’, dan horen we graag van je!


Jouw profiel

Ervaring en competenties

•   Hbo werk- en denkniveau.

•   7+ jaar in growth/performance marketing of vergelijkbare data-gedreven SaaS-rol.

•   Sterk in strategie én executie; van visie naar vandaag nog live experimenten.

•   Analytisch: hypotheses, statistiek, funnel metrics, cohort analyses, CAC, LTV, incrementality.

•   Ervaring met A/B-testing, experiment design, CRO en gedragspsychologie.

•   Ervaren in samenwerking met Product, Design en Data; comfortabel in technisch productteam.

•   Bekend met GA4, HubSpot, Mixpanel/Amplitude, Looker/Power BI, Segment/Stitch, AI-tooling.

•   Creatief, schaal- en impactgericht, pragmatisch, eigenaarschap, hoog tempo.

•   Kwaliteitsgericht in de breedste zin.

Motivatie; je optimaliseert wordt blij van groei. En wordt blij van resultaat en je vindt de marketing puzzel leuk en enthousiasmeert je collega’s voor jouw vak en de impact die je maakt.

Persoonlijk: je gedreven en betrokken, oprecht en geeft je mening graag. Je deelt en geeft inzichten en werkt graag samen omdat het dan beter wordt. Je kan omgaan met feedback.  Je neemt graag verantwoordelijkheid en neemt de regie voor jouw werk

jobs.title: Closed Procedure: Senior Account Director - Strategic Account in Maritime Logistics for SITA
jobs.description:
Senior Account Director - Strategic Account in Maritime Logistics for SITA

 

Executive summary: A senior international key account role for a professional who excels in relationship management, stakeholder engagement, and strategic account development. In this position, you will be responsible for retaining, deepening, and further strengthening the partnership with one of SITA’s ( https://www.sita.aero/about-us/ )  most strategic clients.

Highlights: Senior Account Director - Strategic Account in Maritime Logistics | SITA

·      End-to-end responsibility for a strategic international key account

·      Strong focus on relationship management, retention, and deepening the partnership with C-level, IT directors, Enterprise architects, both on the IT organization of the client as well the Business organization.

·      International sales and stakeholder management role with high visibility in the customer environment

·      Significant impact on client satisfaction, continuity and commercial development, including revenue management

·      Strong focus on managed IT and Connectivity services (infrastructure) and differentiated value propositions, based on the portfolio of SITA

·      Key position within an international team and complex IT enterprise and Business environment

·      Operational / dotted leadership of a highly skilled IT team of 6 FTE at client site

 

Purpose of the role

For SITA, we are looking for a Senior Account Director who will take international responsibility for the strategic international key account. In this role, the emphasis is on retaining, deepening, and future-proofing an existing client relationship with significant commercial and operational value. The focus is not on aggressive revenue growth, but on stability, continuity and additional commercial opportunities within an established international account.

 

About the role, building future proof relationships

As Senior Account Director, you will be responsible for managing and further developing the strategic international key account within SITA. You will operate in an international environment where relationship development focusing on account retention, you understand the complexity of enterprise. IT, data and connectivity sales and know how to create structural value within an existing client relationship.

 

The ideal candidate is an experienced sales professional with proven knowledge of strategic international key account as an organization, for example from a previous role as a supplier or strategic partner. IT knowledge and experience with managed services are important, but deep client knowledge, insight into decision-making structures, and an understanding of international stakeholder dynamics are even more critical in this position. You can build sustainable relationships at multiple levels, create internal and external alignment in a smart and distinctive way.

 

About SITA

SITA has been a leading technology partner for the international travel and transport sector since 1949. In its early years, the SITA company built one of the first large-scale communications networks for aviation and today continues to play a global role in making travel and logistics processes smarter, safer, and more efficient. SITA has since expanded this expertise into maritime services and managed services for logistics organizations

 

SITA supports organizations with contact center solutions, connectivity, digital collaboration, security, and managed services. Within this context, strategic international key account for whom SITA delivers services worldwide that directly contribute to customer contact, collaboration, and operational continuity.

Client context

The strategic international key account one of the world’s leading container shipping and logistics companies, with approximately 18.000 employees globally, 340 + offices in 120 + countries, and connections to more than 550 ports worldwide. The organization is known for its strong focus on quality, digitalization, customer centricity, and operational excellence.

For this role, insight into the international dynamics of a complex logistics organization is essential. You understand how technology, service delivery, and stakeholder management come together in an environment where continuity, reliability, and client satisfaction have a direct impact on the business.

The partnership between SITA and the strategic international key account is built on a strong foundation. Your assignment will be to further deepen this relationship, strengthen SITA’s position, and carefully and strategically develop new opportunities within the account.

 

Portfolio and services at the key account

·       Contact centre and voice solutions

·       Global connectivity solutions

·       Managed services for communication and office environments

·       Management of digital workplaces and office environments

·       Security solutions

 

What will you do?

·       You will have end-to-end responsibility for the international account management strategic key account within SITA.

·       You will build and deepen sustainable relationships with stakeholders at operational, tactical, and strategic levels.

·       You will safeguard the existing revenue base and drive maximum client retention in an environment where managed services are largely viewed as a commodity.

·       You will identify commercial opportunities and translate them into distinctive, relevant, and viable propositions.

·       You will clearly operate as a farmer rather than a hunter account retention, and strategic growth is the main focus.

·       You will position SITA as a partner that adds value more intelligently, effectively, and innovatively than the market expects.

·       You will work effectively with internal teams, senior stakeholders, and specialists to serve the client optimally.

·       You will provide day-to-day direction to a highly skilled IT delivery team of 6 FTE at the client (virtual and extended account team).

 

Terms of employment

This position offers a fixed gross monthly salary between €9.000,- and €11.000,- gross monthly, complemented by an attractive variable compensation model. The bonus structure consists of a sales incentive based on revenue, with approximately 40% of the variable compensation linked to renewals. In addition, you will receive commission on closed deals. With strong performance, a total package of up to approximately €160,000 OTE is achievable.

Procedure

Following a successful introductory phone call, you will have 2 face-to-face meetings with a SoundPeople senior consultant. If both sides see sufficient reason to move forward, we will introduce you to SITA. You will then go through three interview rounds with the client:

 

The first interview round will take place with a Account Executive of SITA (Central Europe) and an HR professional. The second round will be with the SVP of Central Europe and the current Account Director. In the final stage, the ultimate selection and terms of employment will be aligned with the President of Europe and the COO.

 

Interested?

 

This opportunity is designed for an accomplished enterprise account leader who understands that a mature strategic relationship still requires energy, precision and continuous development. If you can combine executive stakeholder management with commercial ownership and coordinated delivery, we would like to hear from you.

 

Contact Sven Fremeijer at Sound People BV, Executive Search

LinkedIn:  https://www.linkedin.com/in/svenfremeijer/


Who are we looking for?

We are looking for a senior sales professional with extensive experience in complex enterprise environments and a strong understanding of international client dynamics. Ideally, you know the strategic international key account from a supplier or partner perspective and understand the organization, its decision-making processes, and the interests at play. You combine commercial sharpness with high-level know how to create momentum based on trust, substance, and personal leadership.

 

·      Proven experience in MSP, IT, managed services and/or Telco environments

·      Deep client knowledge and preferably previous experience with strategic key account

·      Creative, innovative, and strategically strong in commercial positioning

·      Excellent networker and a credible sparring partner at C-level

·      Structured, results-driven, and operationally strong

·      Able to move organizations forward through relationships and trust, rather than hierarchy or pressure

·      Must: Excellent communication skills in an international environment.

jobs.title: Ausbildung Fachinformatiker:in für Systemintegration (all genders) - Standort Frankfurt
jobs.description:
Mit über 650 Kolleg:innen an 19 Standorten in ganz Deutschland gestalten wir bei teccle die Zukunft der IT. Seit 2020 bringen wir starke IT-Unternehmen mit unterschiedlichsten Schwerpunkten unter einem Dach zusammen - und entwickeln uns so zu einem der führenden IT-Dienstleister im Land. Unser Ziel: IT-Lösungen schaffen, die wirklich weiterhelfen - verständlich, flexibel und zukunftsfähig. Für unsere Kund:innen und gemeinsam mit einem Team, das Technik genauso liebt wie neue Ideen.

Als Teil der teccle group sucht die teccle motion engagierte Auszubildende zum/zur Fachinformatiker:in Systemintegration (all genders) ab 01.08.2027.

Für uns sind Auszubildende von Anfang an Kolleg:innen auf Augenhöhe. Wir legen Wert auf eine praxisnahe Ausbildung, persönliche Förderung und ein starkes Miteinander im Team. Bei erfolgreichem Abschluss deiner Ausbildung bieten wir dir gerne die Möglichkeit zur Übernahme und langfristige Perspektiven bei der teccle group. #letsteccleit

Was du bei uns lernst

Bei uns arbeitest du praxisnah, wirst Teil eines Teams und wächst mit deinen Aufgaben. Das erwartet dich in deiner Ausbildung:

  • Praxisnahe Arbeit mit modernen IT-Systemen - von Client- bis Server-Architekturen

  • IT-Systeme und Netzwerke planen, aufbauen und am Laufen halten - damit alles rund läuft

  • Netzwerktechnologien anwenden und vertiefen sowie Hosting- und Cloud-Lösungen nutzen

  • Hard- und Software einrichten, testen und pflegen - Hightech zum Anfassen inklusive

  • IT-Sicherheit im Blick behalten und Systeme so absichern, dass Hacker keine Chance haben

  • Fehler finden, Probleme lösen und Systeme optimieren - mit Köpfchen und Teamgeist

  • Dokumentationen erstellen und Anwender:innen unterstützen, damit Technik für alle verständlich bleibt

  • Spannende Einblicke in wichtige Unternehmensbereiche wie Vertrieb und Buchhaltung

  • IT-Fachkenntnisse vertiefen und ausbauen mit Unterstützung erfahrener IT-Expert:innen sowie durch regelmäßige Workshops und Schulungen

Womit du bei uns glänzt

Niemand erfüllt jede Anforderung. Wenn du neugierig bist und Begeisterung mitbringst, freuen wir uns auch dann auf deine Bewerbung, wenn nicht alles zu 100% passt.

  • Du kannst einen mindestens guten Schulabschluss vorweisen mit guten Noten in Englisch und Deutsch

  • Du bringst einen guten Teamgeist und Entscheidungsfreude mit

  • Du hast eine sorgfältige und eigenständige Arbeitsweise

  • Du hast eine gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit und eine Kunden- und Serviceorientierung

  • Du hast kaufmännisches Denken und Verhandlungsgeschick (z.B. bei der Kalkulation von Kosten für Eigen- und Fremdleistungen, bei Vertragsverhandlungen)

  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch - im Team, mit Kund:innen und im Alltag

  • Du lebst in Frankfurt am Main und Umgebung und bist berechtigt in Deutschland zu arbeiten - so können wir im Alltag gut und reibungslos zusammenarbeiten

 

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

Starte deine Ausbildung in einem Team, das dich unterstützt und dir richtig gute Extras bietet:

  • Mehr Freiheit: 28 Tage Urlaub und flexible Arbeitszeiten

  • Arbeiten, wie es zu dir passt: Nach den ersten Monaten nach Absprache ein Tag pro Woche von zuhause möglich

  • Wissen, das weiterbringt: Individuelle Förderung, praxisnahes Lernen und Raum für deine Entwicklung

  • Willkommenskultur mit Herz: Youngster Days zum Kennenlernen, ein kollegiales Team und echtes Miteinander

  • Gutes Arbeitsumfeld: Moderne Technik und klare Abläufe machen dir den Einstieg leicht

  • Sichere und faire Konditionen: attraktives Ausbildungsgehalt, betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Unterstützung über meinEAP, unser kostenloses Beratungsangebot - auch für deine Familie

  • Zukunft bei der teccle group: Wir bilden aus mit dem Ziel, dich nach erfolgreichem Abschluss zu übernehmen

  

Vielfalt macht uns stärker - deshalb fördern wir bewusst ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem alle Menschen willkommen sind.
Unabhängig von sozialer oder ethnischer Herkunft, Geschlecht, Alter, Religion oder Weltanschauung, Behinderung, sexueller Identität und Orientierung: Wir bieten allen Bewerbenden einen fairen Prozess und gerechte Chancen. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen, die unsere Haltung zu Vielfalt, Gleichberechtigung und Inklusion teilen – und Lust haben, gemeinsam mit uns eine inklusive Arbeitswelt zu gestalten.

What success looks like

  • You take ownership of a high-volume data domain and keep it stable and scalable

  • You bring structure to evolving systems while staying flexible in a dynamic environment

What we offer

jobs.title: iOS Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations.

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things.

 

Role

As an iOS Software Engineer, you own the iOS client experience, how AI feels, responds, and performs in users’ hands. This is not a thin integration role. You will build a production-grade iOS application where AI interactions are central to product experience, and performance, reliability, and user trust are critical.

 

Focus

  • Build and maintain iOS applications using Swift and SwiftUI.

  • Integrate AI-powered features through backend APIs.

  • Design UX patterns for AI interactions, including loading states, streaming responses, retries, and fallbacks.

  • Optimize performance, memory usage, and battery efficiency.

  • Capture user signals and feedback to support AI evaluation and iteration.

  • Collaborate closely with backend and ML engineers on API design and system behavior.

  • Maintain high App Store quality, stability, and production reliability.

 

Ideal Experiences

  • 3+ years of iOS development experience using Swift.

  • Hands-on experience integrating AI-powered features into mobile apps.

  • Strong understanding of async/await, concurrency, and background tasks.

  • Solid iOS performance and memory optimization skills.

  • Experience shipping and maintaining production iOS apps.

  • Comfort designing for latency, partial failure, and non-deterministic AI behavior.

  • Exposure to CoreML or light on-device ML.

  • Familiarity with feature flags or remote configuration systems.

  • Strong intuition for AI UX patterns and user trust considerations.

 

Outcomes

  • Stable, smooth, and reliable real-world use iOS applications.

  • Performance is optimized: responsive, low-latency, and efficient on memory and CPU.

  • Production issues are detected early, monitored effectively, and resolved with clear root-cause analysis.

 

Tech Stack

  • Swift

  • SPM

  • SwiftUI

  • SQL / noSQL

  • TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)

 

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

 

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.
